symptom: L'addon PvP est chargé à la demande (LoadAddOn) bien après la connexion. Ses options cochées (ex. masquer les cadres de raid) reviennent aux valeurs par défaut à chaque chargement.
code:
1: ---@class WarLegendPvP
   2: local WarLegendPvP = WarLegendPvP
   3: 
   4: -- Loaded on demand by WarLegendRaidTool (PvP.lua), usually after the login: PLAYER_LOGIN and the
   5: -- PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD of the battleground already happened, so run them once now.
   6: if IsLoggedIn() then
   7:     WarLegendPvP:PLAYER_LOGIN()
   8:     WarLegendPvP:PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD()
   9: end
  10:
fix:
diff --git a/WarLegendRaidTool_PvP/Startup.lua b/WarLegendRaidTool_PvP/Startup.lua
index 0b3a6ab..32c40de 100644
--- a/WarLegendRaidTool_PvP/Startup.lua
+++ b/WarLegendRaidTool_PvP/Startup.lua
@@ -1,9 +1,19 @@
 ---@class WarLegendPvP
 local WarLegendPvP = WarLegendPvP
+---@type string
+local AddonName = ...
 
 -- Loaded on demand by WarLegendRaidTool (PvP.lua), usually after the login: PLAYER_LOGIN and the
--- PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD of the battleground already happened, so run them once now.
+-- PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD of the battleground already happened, so run them once now. Not while the files
+-- run: the saved settings (WarLegendRaidTool_PvPDB) are only there at this addon's ADDON_LOADED, which
+-- LoadAddOn fires before it returns.
 if IsLoggedIn() then
-	WarLegendPvP:PLAYER_LOGIN()
-	WarLegendPvP:PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD()
+	local starter = CreateFrame("Frame")
+	starter:RegisterEvent("ADDON_LOADED")
+	starter:SetScript("OnEvent", function(self, _, name)
+		if name ~= AddonName then return end
+		self:UnregisterEvent("ADDON_LOADED")
+		WarLegendPvP:PLAYER_LOGIN()
+		WarLegendPvP:PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD()
+	end)
 end
